candidates.title: TrailForge Ridge Hiking Boots
reviews: Two years of daily trail use and the stitching is still perfect.
Held up through rocks, mud and snow. Built like a tank.
Wore them 500+ miles, zero wear on the sole.

candidates.title: PeakStep Lite Hiking Boots
reviews: The sole started peeling off after three weeks.
Cheap glue, the toe cap split on my first hike.
Looks nice but fell apart fast.
